subject: Storage credits & trace/dashboard SKU alignment for ACME Health
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storage + Tracing + Dashboards — alignment request

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the dashboard previews. Before we move to procurement, procurement legal asked for a clearer breakdown of the add-on economics (retention buckets + tracing egress) and whether there’s room for an onboarding credit to help with the first-quarter overage risk.

Specific asks:
- Can you map ACME’s current monthly ingestion (attached) to the retention tiers and show expected monthly bill for the first 6 months?
- Is there a standard onboarding/implementation credit you’d offer for a 12‑month commitment?
- For tracing: any change in unit price if we commit to 6M spans/month?

I attached our usage export for August. Budget owner is cc’d (ops-team@acmehealth.com) — they need the numbers by end of next week.

Thanks,
Daniel

Attachments: ACME_usage_Aug.csv (csv)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, ops-team@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storage + Tracing + Dashboards — alignment request

Hi Daniel — appreciate the clear asks and the upload. I ran a quick mapping against the tiers we spoke about and there are a couple of pathways we can take; attached is a short one‑pager (Proposal_v3.pdf) that lays out three options at a glance.

High level:
- Option A (conservative): keep retention at standard slab pricing; apply a one‑time onboarding credit that covers estimated first‑month surge.
- Option B (commit): 12‑month retention commitment with a graduated discount on storage tiers + reduced tracing unit price at 6M spans/month.
- Option C (pilot): 3‑month pilot with a larger onboarding credit in exchange for a 12‑month purchase option at the end.

I’ll loop in Jordan (pricing) and Kimberly (enterprise CS/legal handoff) to confirm the credit ranges. Do you have a preferred date/time for a 30‑minute call next week to walk through the spreadsheet and pick a path?

If helpful, I can also provide a modeled cost table by month for the first 6 months — quick to generate once we align on Option A/B/C.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0177

Attachments: Proposal_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: ACME — credit/concession framing (need signoff)

Jordan / Kim — forwarding Daniel’s asks and the usage file. Quick framing for discussion:

Context: ACME is comfortable with the base product but procurement is sensitive to first‑quarter overages and wants clear cost predictability. They already use a moderate volume of spans (attached in the usage csv).

Proposed concession paths (numbers are draft):
1) One‑time onboarding credit: $12.5k — covers anticipated surge and tooling work. Requires no change to ongoing pricing, contract language to note as one‑time non‑recurring credit.
2) Tiered commit: 12‑month retention commitment at 20% discount on storage above the base 3TB bucket + tracing unit price reduced by 15% at >=6M spans/month. This moves ARR but reduces unit economics.
3) Pilot + conversion: 3‑month pilot with $20k onboarding credit, convert to 12‑month term at a negotiated rate if they convert within 30 days.

Questions:
- Which option preserves margin while being most likely to close?
- If we do the $12.5k credit, can we offer a smaller credit in exchange for a short-term guarantee (e.g., commit to pay pilot rate for 3 months)?

I’ve attached a simple calc (concession_calc.xlsx) with model assumptions — please flag if the inputs look off. Need a decision by Tue 9/29 EOD to get procurement numbers back to them Monday.

Thanks,
Hannah

Attachments: concession_calc.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: ACME — credit/concession framing (need signoff)

Thanks — reviewed the calc. A couple of notes:
- Option 1 ($12.5k one‑time) is probably the quickest close and keeps renewal economics intact. Approve from pricing if we make it contingent on a minimum 6‑month invoice cadence (no refunds).
- Option 2 margin impact: 20% on volumes above 3TB is steep; suggest 12% instead with a usage floor (so we don’t get crowded by low‑yield high‑volume accounts). We should also cap the trace discount to the first 12 months.
- Option 3 (pilot): legal will want clear SOW milestones before we hand over a $20k credit — that slows the timeline.

I’ll touch base with Legal to confirm acceptable contract language for the credit and the usage floor. If Legal is good with the 12% / usage floor, I think we can present Option 2 as our preferred. Otherwise, present Option 1 as the fast close.

Jordan
Sr. Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: concession_calc.xlsx (referred)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>, ops-team@acmehealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storage + Tracing + Dashboards — alignment request

Daniel — thanks for the patience. Based on the internal review here’s a clean set of proposals (pick one) and I’ll prep a short SOW + DocuSign after you confirm which path you prefer.

Option A — Fast close (lowest friction):
- One‑time onboarding credit: $12,500 applied to first invoice.
- Standard retention slab pricing remains unchanged.
- No change to tracing unit price.
- Requirement: 6‑month invoice cadence (no refunds).

Option B — Commit (best price predictability):
- 12‑month retention commitment. 12% discount on storage volumes above the base 3TB bucket for the first 12 months.
- Tracing: 15% reduced unit price once monthly spans >= 6M (first 12 months only).
- Usage floor: minimum monthly bill of $8k to preserve economics.

Option C — Pilot to convert (higher upfront credit):
- 3‑month pilot with $18k onboarding credit.
- If converted to a 12‑month term within 30 days after pilot, credit is retained and 10% discount applied to storage for remainder of term.

Next steps:
1) Tell me which option you prefer and I’ll return a short SOW + pricing appendix.
2) Proposed call: Tue 10/5 10:00AM PT or Wed 10/6 9:00AM PT — which works for your team?

I’ve also attached a sample SOW and the modeled month‑by‑month costs for Option A/B (for your budget owner). Links below: SOW (DocuSign draft): https://docusign.com/s/placeholder-sow-acme and drive folder with the model: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/ACME-789-proposal.

If you want us to tighten the numbers further, Jordan can run a final sensitivity table for expected overage scenarios.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0177

Attachments: Sample_SOW.pdf (pdf), Proposal_v3.pdf (referred)
